value.rationale: A simple, standard piecewise exponential IFR lifetime family exhibits a unique source-specific nonexponential blind point, an exact sign-reversal boundary, and an approximately 67.5-fold imbalance in positive vs negative contrast extrema. Smooth full-support strictly increasing analytic hazards preserve exact blindness, ruling out a discontinuity artifact. This meaningfully delimits the reach of the published selected single contrast and motivates using multiple record indices without asserting empirical power from zero population signal.
